subject: general
question: The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) provides legal assurance of wage employment in rural areas. Under MGNREGA, how many days of guaranteed wage employment per year is a rural household entitled to?
solution:
The correct answer is __**100 days**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)** was enacted in **2005** to provide legal assurance of wage employment to rural households in India.
 
• Under the provisions of MGNREGA, each rural household is entitled to **100 days of guaranteed wage employment per year**.
 
• The scheme aims to enhance livelihood security by offering **unskilled manual work** to rural households.
 
• MGNREGA mandates that the work provided should be within **5 kilometers** of the worker's residence, and if the distance exceeds this limit, additional wages for travel must be paid.
 
• The Act also emphasizes **gender equality** by ensuring equal wages for men and women and promoting women's participation in the workforce.
 
• MGNREGA is implemented by local authorities, including Gram Panchayats, and focuses on creating durable assets such as roads, ponds, and canals in rural areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Objectives of MGNREGA:**

 
 
• To provide **social protection** for the most vulnerable sections of society.
 
• To create **durable rural assets** and strengthen the rural economy.
 
• To reduce **urban migration** by improving employment opportunities in rural areas.
 
• To promote **decentralized planning** and governance through Gram Sabhas and Panchayati Raj Institutions.
 
 
 
• **Features of MGNREGA:**
 
 
• MGNREGA guarantees **universal access** to employment for rural households, irrespective of caste, gender, or community.
 
• Any adult member of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual labor can apply for work under this scheme.
 
• Employment must be provided within **15 days** of application, failing which unemployment allowance is payable.
 
• The scheme focuses on **sustainable development** and natural resource management, such as water conservation, afforestation, and soil erosion prevention.
 
 
 
• **Funding and Implementation:**
 
 
• MGNREGA is a **centrally sponsored scheme**, with funding shared between the **Central and State Governments**.
 
• The Central Government bears **100% of the cost** for unskilled labor, 75% of the material costs, and 100% of administrative expenses.
 
• State Governments are responsible for unemployment allowances in case employment is not provided within the stipulated timeframe.
 
 
 
• **Impact of MGNREGA:**
 
 
• MGNREGA has significantly contributed to **poverty alleviation** by offering a steady income to rural households.
 
• It has enhanced **women's empowerment** by increasing their participation in the workforce and improving their financial independence.
 
• The program has facilitated **asset creation**, including infrastructure development and environmental conservation in rural areas.
 
• MGNREGA has also strengthened **democratic processes** by encouraging community participation in planning and implementation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Challenges in Implementation:**

 
 
• Delayed payment of wages has been a major issue, affecting worker morale and participation.
 
• Corruption and misuse of funds in certain areas have hindered the effective implementation of the scheme.
 
• Insufficient capacity building and awareness among rural communities have limited their participation and benefits.
 
• In some regions, political interference and lack of accountability have affected the transparency of operations.
 
 
 
• **Notable Achievements:**
 
 
• MGNREGA has been instrumental in reducing **rural unemployment** and providing a social safety net to vulnerable communities.
 
• It has led to improved **infrastructure development** and environmental sustainability in rural areas.
 
• The program has enhanced **livelihood security** and minimized distress migration.
 
• Its focus on gender equality has empowered women and improved their socio-economic status.
